messages:
mira: deploy-bot just blocked chart promotion for payments-service — says dependency lock mismatch for subchart billing-ui. any context?

deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: promotion halted by preflight check.
error: Chart.lock and Chart.yaml dependency versions differ for 'billing-ui' (Chart.lock: 1.4.0, Chart.yaml: 1.5.0).
action: pause promotion, open ticket REL-1234, notify @eng-releases.

sam: saw this in CI earlier — dev bumped billing-ui to 1.5.0 but we forgot to run `helm dependency update` before packaging the chart. CI artifact has old lock.

jeff: can we just pin promotion to the previous chart version for now and roll the bump in a follow-up? what's the risk of rolling forward here? :thinking:

tao: rolling forward requires regenerating Chart.lock and verifying subchart values didn't change shape. quick check: run locally
```
helm repo update
helm dependency update ./charts/payments-service
helm package ./charts/payments-service --dependency-update
```
then run the preflight suite against the canary namespace.

mira: prefer to avoid emergency pin if we can fix the lock within change window. but EU change window opens at 14:00 PT — if we can't confirm in 30m we should pin and ship US only.

sam: I can regenerate the lock and push a hotfix chart branch, but need someone to sanity-run the canary smoke tests. tagging @jeff.

jeff: I can run smoke tests after you push. If smoke passes, we do a manual promote for both regions. If not, pin US to previous chart and open rollback playbook. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: NOTE: created REL-1234 with checklist: [regenerate-lock, run-smoke-canary, update-release-notes, manual-promote-if-ok]. Assigned to sam.

sam: pushing branch: `hotfix/chart-lock/billing-ui-1.5.0` now. contains updated Chart.lock and rebuilt tgz.

# values excerpt that changed (for context):
```yaml
billing-ui:
  image:
    repository: redwood/billing-ui
    tag: "v1.5.0"
  featureFlags:
    auditMode: true
```

jeff: smoke tests: health ok, frontend renders checkout, e2e payments flow passes (sanity). logs looked normal. :eyes:

mira: nice. sam, once you push the packaged chart to the staging registry, update the release notes with a short bullet: "billing-ui subchart bumped to v1.5.0 — regenerated Chart.lock; no breaking config changes." Also note the EU rollout will proceed in the 14:00 PT window.

sam: release note added in REL-1234 and pushed chart tgz to artifactory. ready for manual promote.

jaff???: (typo)

jeff: initiating manual promote for payments-service -> will run `deploy-bot promote --chart payments-service-1.12.0.tgz --target all-regions --manual` and watch.

deploy-bot: ACTION: manual promote requested by jeff. Starting promotion to US, then EU after 2m steady state check. Logs: https://ci.internal/rels/REL-1234/logs

mira: holding EU until post-canary metrics stable, if anything spikes we'll rollback to payments-service-1.11.7 and reopen REL-1234.

sam: acknowledged, monitoring.

jeff: all green in US, signs stable for 3m. proceeding to EU now.

mira: thanks team — capture brief note in the release notes about the Chart.lock mishap and mitigation steps (regen lock + CI preflight tightened). :white_check_mark:

sam: will follow up with a tiny CI tweak to fail packaging when Chart.lock drift detected. PR incoming.

jeff: perfect. closing thread once REL-1234 status = released. :shipit:
